Here I made a video that I sent to my brother about these problems.

The way I have it set up now is I've sealed the tanks off with J.B. SteelStik epoxy. It was all I had laying around, so I tried it, thought it would work. It didn't. Now, I'm thinking about designing my own cap and sending the drawing to a 3D printing company to print the design out with a strong plastic.
